capabilities.name: changefeed-follow
capabilities.limitation: bounded authenticated long-poll fallback over the same commit-ordered replay used by durable WebSocket subscriptions

capabilities.name: changefeed-replay
capabilities.limitation: authenticated retained cursor replay with lossless claim and typed data snapshots

capabilities.name: claim-transactions
capabilities.limitation: schema-less reasoning-claim transactions on rrflow_kv; schema-bound models use the multi-model transaction contract

capabilities.name: context-assembly
capabilities.limitation: bounded authenticated temporal context assembly with source and read evidence; attunement and release recall-quality gates remain open

capabilities.name: endpoint-catalogue
capabilities.limitation: machine-readable operation catalogue and OpenAPI 3.1 schemas; generated language packages and shared conformance remain F5 work

capabilities.name: estate-authority-read
capabilities.limitation: read-only estate snapshots; estate mutations remain unavailable

capabilities.name: exact-rrflowql-query
capabilities.limitation: exact session-scoped rrflowQL reads over authenticated typed versions with Arrow/DataFusion compute; mutating rrflowQL remains open

capabilities.name: governed-reasoning-runner
capabilities.limitation: operator ceilings are configured, but the governed reasoning executor and activation receipts are not implemented; private exploratory reasoning remains outside this durable-effect capability

capabilities.name: jwt-session-credentials
capabilities.limitation: configure an owner-only JWT key file and matching persisted issuer

capabilities.name: knowledge-tree-catalogue
capabilities.limitation: authenticated project-bound catalogue configuration with revision compare-and-swap and idempotent receipts; external bindings do not establish provider execution or synchronization

capabilities.name: live-subscriptions
capabilities.limitation: authenticated WebSocket push with durable ACK cursors, fenced reconnect, bounded delivery windows, and one global commit-cursor order

capabilities.name: local-transport-leases
capabilities.limitation: principal-authenticated policy-bound loopback sessions; configure mTLS for remote transport

capabilities.name: logical-backup-restore
capabilities.limitation: content-authenticated logical backup and restore-to-generated-new-root; object payloads are referenced-only and restore never switches the active instance

capabilities.name: multi-model-transactions
capabilities.limitation: atomic schema, claim, record, relation, event, vector, series, geo, and pre-staged object-reference commits with durable all-model prospective read-your-writes; mutating rrflowQL remains open

capabilities.name: remote-listen
capabilities.limitation: plain HTTP is loopback-only; configure mTLS and initialize security for remote bind

capabilities.name: rrflow-parquet-1
capabilities.limitation: authenticated bounded query-result export only; uncompressed typed Arrow profile; no import, streaming, destination writes or global allocator qualification

capabilities.name: security-audit
capabilities.limitation: independently hash-chained redacted JSON audit with protected bounded read and canonical JSON Lines export; external sink delivery remains adapter-owned

capabilities.name: security-policy
capabilities.limitation: revisioned principals, inherited roles, credentials, issuers, external identity bindings, exact resource grants, and compiled tenant/row/field rrflowQL policy; constrained operations without an injector deny

capabilities.name: vector-search
capabilities.limitation: named collections, typed payload indexes and filters, direct stamped dense/sparse/multi-vector reads, and persisted HNSW/quantization/TurboQuant artifact serving; release recall-quality gates remain open
